name: Sonoma
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Sonoma, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Sonoma, CA for 2026: a lighted tractor parade, Santa on the Plaza, winery Santa days and lantern walks.
lede: Sonoma gathers around its historic Plaza for the Lighting of the Plaza, a lighted tractor parade and Santa's fire truck arrival, then spreads to wineries, a state historic park and a botanical garden in Glen Ellen.
celebrates: Sonoma's season centers on the historic Plaza. The Lighting of the Plaza draws hundreds of people in the cold and rain, and the Sonoma Valley Vintners and Growers Alliance and the City of Sonoma present the Lighted Tractor Parade the following weekend. Santa arrives on an antique fire truck and lights the tree at City Hall with the Soroptimists and the Sonoma Valley Volunteer Firefighters Association. Sonoma State Historic Park hosts a free holiday evening, wineries add Santa photo days, and Sonoma Botanical Garden in Glen Ellen offers lantern walks.
lastyear: Sonoma held its third annual Lighted Tractor Parade on Saturday, November 29, 2025, at 6:30 pm, according to the Sonoma Index-Tribune. Decorated vineyard tractors, farm trucks and festive trailers, each draped in bright lights and garland, rolled around the perimeter of the Plaza while families bundled up against the chill. The paper called it a free, family friendly event, and it followed the Sonoma Sip N Shop on the Plaza earlier in the day.
facts: Organizers say Sonoma's Lighted Tractor Parade commemorates the city's agricultural heritage and community spirit, which is why vineyard tractors and farm trucks take the lead. The 2025 parade was the third annual, so this year's is the fourth. Sonoma Plaza is also the setting for Santa's fire truck arrival, when the city says Santa lights the tree in front of City Hall. This year's Lighting of the Plaza, on November 21, went ahead in heavy rain.
trains: Sonoma has no holiday train of its own, but two rail outings are within reach. The Napa Valley Wine Train runs from Napa on a line finished in 1864 and offers a Santa Train Jolly Journeys daytime ride in late December. The Western Railway Museum in Suisun City runs Santa Trains in December, where children ride, meet Santa, write him a letter and make an ornament, according to our museum guide.
train_links: A heritage dining train on a line finished in 1864, listed on our museum guide.
Streetcars and interurbans to ride, with Santa Trains in December, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Sonoma's beloved opening night of the holiday lights on the Plaza.
Decorated vineyard tractors and trailers circle the Plaza on the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
Santa arrives by antique fire truck and lights the tree at City Hall.
A free holiday evening with carols at Sonoma State Historic Park.
Larson Family Winery and Cline Family Cellars host Santa photos and storytime.
kidfact: Sonoma's tractor parade uses real vineyard tractors, so the lights roll by on machines that work in the fields.
faq: Sonoma gathers on the historic Plaza for the Lighting of the Plaza, the Lighted Tractor Parade and Santa's fire truck arrival with a tree lighting at City Hall. Sonoma State Historic Park hosts a holiday evening with carols, and nearby wineries and Sonoma Botanical Garden add Santa photos, a North Pole Express and lantern walks.
Is the Sonoma Lighted Tractor Parade free?

Yes. The Sonoma Index-Tribune called the 2025 parade a free, family friendly event, and the Sonoma Valley Vintners and Growers Alliance lists this year's parade at 6:30 pm on the Plaza. Streets around the Plaza close beforehand, so arrive early and expect to walk in from side streets.
How does Santa arrive on the Sonoma Plaza?

According to the City of Sonoma, Santa rides in on an antique fire truck with local firefighters, then lights the tree in front of City Hall and takes time for pictures. Children can tell him their Christmas wishes, and the Soroptimists and the Sonoma Valley Volunteer Firefighters Association offer hot chocolate.
Are there winery Santa events in Sonoma?

Yes. Larson Family Winery holds Santa Weekend with family photo sessions, and Cline Family Cellars holds its North Pole Express with cocoa, cookies, photos and storytime. Both are ticketed, and the wineries ask families to reserve ahead, so read each card for the price and the booking page.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sonoma for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (the Lighted Tractor Parade) through December 13 (North Pole Express at Cline Family Cellars and the last lantern walk), with Santa on the Plaza (December 4), the tree lighting at Cornerstone Sonoma (December 4), Holiday on the Northern Frontier (December 12) and Santa Weekend at Larson Family Winery (December 5 and 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Sonoma

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Sonoma
  • 5 free events, including the Lighted Tractor Parade, the Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn and Cornerstone Sonoma tree lightings, the library gingerbread workshop and Holiday on the Northern Frontier
  • Meet Santa: Santa on the Plaza (December 4), Santa Weekend at Larson Family Winery (December 5 and 6) and the North Pole Express at Cline Family Cellars (December 13)
  • Parades, lights and walks: the Lighted Tractor Parade (November 28), the Fairmont tree lighting (December 3) and the Winter Wonder Lantern Walks in Glen Ellen (December 10 to 13)
  • Crafts: the gingerbread house workshop at the Sonoma Valley Regional Library (December 13)
  • Season: November 28 to December 13

Planning a bigger day out? Sonoma families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Napa and Santa Rosa, plus the Napa Valley Wine Train Santa rides.
